sql.value: SELECT po.secondary_price AS secondaryPrice, po.subtotal, po.secondary_quantity AS secondaryQuantity, po.order_no AS orderNo, po.orderDate, po.orderType, jp.`name` as productName, ju.`name` as secondaryUnitName, jp.`code` as productCode, jp.`name` as supplierName, jw.`name` as warehouseName FROM ( SELECT jpii.secondary_price, jpii.subtotal, jpii.secondary_quantity, jpii.secondary_unit_id, jpii.warehouse_id, jpii.product_id, jpi.order_no, '采购入库' as orderType, jpi.supplier_id, jpi.inbound_date AS orderDate FROM jxc_purchase_inbound_item AS jpii LEFT JOIN jxc_purchase_inbound AS jpi ON jpii.purchase_inbound_id = jpi.id WHERE jpi.order_status = '已审核' and jpii.merchant_id = :merchantId #[ AND jpi.inbound_date BETWEEN :startDate AND :endDate] UNION ALL SELECT jpri.secondary_price, - jpri.subtotal as subtotal, - jpri.secondary_quantity as secondary_quantity, jpri.secondary_unit_id, jpri.warehouse_id, jpri.product_id, jpr.order_no, '采购退货' as orderType, jpr.supplier_id, jpr.return_date AS orderDate FROM jxc_purchase_return_item AS jpri LEFT JOIN jxc_purchase_return AS jpr ON jpri.purchase_return_id = jpr.id WHERE jpr.order_status = '已审核' and jpri.merchant_id = :merchantId #[AND jpr.return_date BETWEEN :startDate AND :endDate] ) AS po LEFT JOIN jxc_warehouse AS jw ON jw.id = po.warehouse_id LEFT JOIN jxc_unit AS ju ON ju.id = po.secondary_unit_id LEFT JOIN jxc_product AS jp ON jp.id = po.product_id LEFT JOIN jxc_supplier AS js ON js.id = po.supplier_id WHERE jp.merchant_id = :merchantId #[AND (po.order_no like :filter OR js.name like :filter)] #[AND js.id = :supplierId] #[AND jp.id = :productId] #[AND jw.id = :warehouseId]
